subject: Fabio Cannavaro
title: Cannavaro's dream and the two-goal lead

lines.vo: Cannavaro dreams of Italy. His team just threw away a two-goal lead.
lines.footage: Uzbekistan v Russia Tashkent match highlights

lines.vo: Uzbekistan led Russia two-nil. Russia scored three in nine minutes and won. Quicker than an espresso.
lines.footage: Uzbekistan v Russia 2026 goals and reaction

lines.vo: Five days later, Esanov scored twice in Doha. Uzbekistan beat Saudi Arabia two-one.
Cannavaro sometimes prefers equal or fewer men. More spirit, he says. Bold theory.
He calls the job a quick Neapolitan coffee, about ten days. Contract: autumn twenty twenty-seven. Slow barista.
His dream job is Italy. For now, Uzbekistan is the audition.

inserts.story: A cartoon scoreboard shows 2-0 while the team in dark shirts relaxes on deck chairs. Gag: three rival players sprint in and fire three balls into the net while a tiny espresso cup bounces. Twist: the scoreboard flips to 2-3 and the espresso spills.

A caricature of Cannavaro sips a tiny espresso at a coffee bar while a wall calendar shows ten days. Gag: the calendar pages flip away like a fast fan. Twist: the barista yawns, very slowly pushing over the next cup.
